definitions.short: Joel , the name of twelve Israelites
definitions.full: H3100. Yoel יוֺאֵל proper name, masculine ᵐ5 Ἰωηλ (usually interpreted as ׳י is God , compare אֵלִיָּהוּ ; but Phoenician ֗֗֗ יאל CIS i. 132 l. 4 & in יאלפעל (Louvre) apparently proper name, of deity, perhaps = Iolaos , CIS i. p. 163 & references ; see also Nes Eg 86 RS K 301 ; Nes strong-willed , compare ואל ויל, Sinaitic Inscription , see ואלו Eut Sin. Inschr. No.5 + often, yet compare Dr stud. Bib. i. 5 n .; W in RS l.c. proposes connection with Arabic Wâil in proper name, of a tribe Bakr Wâil (√ take refuge ) compare RS K 194 ) — 1 Samuel's firstborn 1Sam 8:2 , 1Chr 6:18 ; insert also v. 6:13 after ᵐ5 L Ἰωηλ (compare Dr 1Sam 8:2 ). 2 a Simeonite prince 1Chr 4:35 . 3 a Reubenite 1Chr 5:4 , 8 . 4 a Gadite chief 1Chr 5:12 . 5 a chief man of Issachar 1Chr 7:3 . 6 one of David's heroes 1Chr 11:38 . 7 a chief of Manassesh 1Chr 27:20 . 8 a Jew of Ezra's time Ezra 10:43 . 9 a Benjamite Neh 11:9 . 10 the prophet, son of Pethuel Joel 1:1 . 11 Levites a. 1Chr 6:21 ; b. 2Chr 29:12 ; c. 1Chr 15:7 , 11 , 17 , perhaps= d. 1Chr 23:8 ; 26:22 . יוֺאָשׁ see יְהוֺאָשׁ . יוֺזָבָד see יְהוֺזָבָד . p.220.

occurrences.englishText: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;
Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;
David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.
The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of Yahweh’s house.
of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

Then the Levites arose, Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;
Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, and Joel, Benaiah.
Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
Yahweh’s* “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.
